defect: The new TakeGameScreenshot adds a SCREENSHOT_RENDER path (used for savestate screenshots) that yields 8888 buffers, but the Qt branch still wraps every buffer as QImage::Format_RGB888, so Qt savestate screenshots come out garbled.
reason: The fix changes exactly that QImage format line in the file this change created; before the change the Qt path only ever received the 888 display framebuffer, and the diff itself shows 8888 buffers handled in the non-Qt branch.

defect: The main loop now calls graphicsContext->ThreadFrame(true), which blocks waiting for render tasks, and the emu thread no longer calls StopThread, so when the emu thread stops producing frames on exit the main thread hangs.
reason: The fix breaks out of the main loop once the emu thread is QUIT_REQUESTED/STOPPED before calling the blocking ThreadFrame(true), repairing the exit hang created by this rework; seeing it requires GLRenderManager::ThreadFrame's waitIfEmpty semantics.

defect: The fix corrects the DrawPixels stride argument (bytes vs pixels) and binds the destination FBO for block-transfer uploads, and drops the UpdateFromMemory hack.
reason: The DrawPixels call with srcStride * bpp and without binding the target was added earlier (33d15a6) and was only moved from NotifyBlockTransfer into NotifyBlockTransferAfter by this change.

defect: entry.fileName == 'jpn0.pgf' compares a const char* against a string literal by pointer, so the provided-font detection is unreliable.
reason: The comparison was added by this change and the fix wraps it in std::string to compare contents; fontRegistry's string-literal fileName field makes the pointer comparison evident from the diff.

defect: The fix only lowers two log calls (__KernelAllocateVpl and sceKernelFreeVpl) from DEBUG_LOG to VERBOSE_LOG.
reason: Changing a log level is not a defect repair.

defect: enableAlphaTest is computed from gstate.alphaBlendEnable instead of gstate.alphaTestEnable in both ComputeFragmentShaderID and GenerateFragmentShader, breaking the alpha test.
reason: This change replaced alphaTestEnable with alphaBlendEnable in those lines and the fix restores alphaTestEnable; the typo is plain in the diff.

defect: ToggleSwapAxes now takes std::lock_guard on mutex_, but it is invoked from an onVKey handler that already holds mutex_, so the non-recursive mutex is locked twice (deadlock/UB).
reason: The lock_guard line was added by this change and the fix removes it with a note that the lock is already held; knowing the caller path needs the onVKey handler code outside this diff.

defect: The fix replaces direct writes of gstate_c.useShaderDepal with SetUseShaderDepal, which also dirties fragment shader state; the real regression it targets was in Vulkan.
reason: In the GL backend the shader-depal path added here is compiled out (#if 0), so useShaderDepal is never set true and the setter conversion repairs no observable GL defect.

defect: The new Vulkan shader-depal path sets gstate_c.useShaderDepal without dirtying the fragment shader state, never resets it on the non-depal framebuffer paths, and uses shader depal even when texturing from the current render target.
reason: The fix (regression #10993 'caused by the new depal code for Vulkan') rewrites exactly these added lines with SetUseShaderDepal, resets in the else branches and restricts useShaderDepal; the shader-ID dependence lives in other files.

defect: The fix replaces the direct Windows InputBox_GetString/MainWindow::hwndMain use in Core with host->InputBoxGetString to repair the headless build.
reason: The Windows-only InputBox call already existed before this change, which only passed the length through a size_t local.

defect: The fix rewrites the encrypted-PRX buffer allocation (drops alignment, sizes it elf_size+psp_size), fixes the modinfo address lookup and guards a missing .text section.
reason: The change's max(elf_size, psp_size)+0x40 aligned buffer satisfies the decrypter's alignment and size needs; the defects the fix actually repairs (modinfo pointer, .text handling) predate this change.

defect: The fix replaces the back()-only pre-transition deduplication, which ignored the aspect and earlier entries, with a set insert.
reason: The faulty deduplication logic predates this change, which only reordered the TransitionRequest initializer fields.

defect: The fix casts id to u32 in the comparison with SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_NO_MEMORY to silence a signed/unsigned warning.
reason: The comparison already behaved correctly through the usual conversions, so this is a warning cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix changes the local result variables from int to u32 to avoid signed/unsigned comparison warnings against the error constants.
reason: The int comparisons with the error codes worked correctly; this is a warning fix.

defect: The ERROR_LOG_REPORT_ONCE call passes the char array 'offset' for a %i specifier, so it logs garbage instead of the CLUT offset (undefined behaviour).
reason: This change added 'offset=%i' with the offset buffer as argument and the fix passes clutBase with %d; the wrong argument is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix casts width to u32 in 'width == srcStride' to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: For the valid non-negative widths the comparison already gave the right result, so it is a warning fix.

defect: The fix passes an is-top flag to canBeBackground in the background-screen selection loop.
reason: The canBeBackground/backgroundScreen logic was added by later commits (3832b32, 6d51fbc, e8f7059), not by this change, whose 'first' variable was unused.

defect: The new condition 'gpu && !gpu->PresentedThisFrame()' clears the backbuffer every frame in skip-buffer-effects (non-buffered) mode, where the game draws directly to the backbuffer without CopyToOutput, wiping the frame.
reason: The fix adds '&& !skipBufferEffects' to exactly this added condition (and resets viewport/scissor); knowing that non-buffered rendering never sets presentedThisFrame_ needs FramebufferManagerCommon.

defect: The renamed call BindFramebufferAsColorTexture(1, nullptr, ...) still passes nullptr, but the same commit removed the null-to-currentRenderVfb_ fallback, so shader blending dereferences a null framebuffer and crashes.
reason: The fix passes GetCurrentRenderVFB() at this changed call site; the removed fallback is in FramebufferManagerGLES.cpp, outside this file's diff.

defect: The fix drops the redundant dst[realLen] = 0 after resize in the non-Windows ConvertUTF8ToWString.
reason: Writing the null character at index size() is permitted in C++17 and resize already terminates the string, so the fix is a cleanup with no behaviour change.

defect: The fix renames the ini key 'bAchievementsSaveStateInChallengeMode' to 'AchievementsSaveStateInHardcoreMode'.
reason: The stray 'b' prefix in the key predates this change, which only renamed the bound variable.

defect: Replacing the hardcoded 0xFFbd9939 title bar with theme colors picked itemFocusedStyle, which changes the store title's look, while the original color matches itemDownStyle.
reason: The fix (reported in the same PR #19550) switches the two added lines to itemDownStyle; that 0xFFBD9939 is the down-style background is only visible in UI/Theme.cpp.

defect: The fix casts the size_t loop index to int for the %d in snprintf to silence a format warning.
reason: On the supported little-endian targets the key name was produced correctly, so this is a warning cleanup rather than a behaviour fix.

defect: The new AllocMemoryBlock failure log has %s, %i, %08x, %08x specifiers but no arguments, so printf reads garbage (the %s can crash) when allocation fails.
reason: This change added the argument-less ERROR_LOG and the fix supplies pname, type, size and paramsAddr; the missing arguments are plain in the diff.

defect: The fix logs inst.encoding instead of the Opcode struct for %08x in the 'no replacement op' error.
reason: The single-u32 Opcode struct is passed through varargs as its encoding on the supported ABIs, so this is a warning fix with no practical behaviour change.

defect: The fix reports outtextlength as the number of entered characters (currentInputChar) instead of outtextlimit.
reason: When this change set outtextlength = outtextlimit it was writing outtextlimit fake '0' characters, so it was consistent; the mismatch arose when 'Make OSK work' (60e831b) added real input.

defect: convertYCbCrToABGR packs red at bit 16 and blue at bit 0 (ARGB), so sceJpegCsc writes images with red and blue swapped.
reason: This change added the function and the fix swaps r and b in its return; the name ABGR versus the packing is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix makes the RGB-to-YCbCr conversion read the pixel as ABGR (red at bit 0) instead of ARGB.
reason: The wrong channel extraction in convertARGBToYCbCr predates this change, which only renamed the local variables from abgr to argb.

defect: The fix moves cancelScreensAbove into LaunchFile for non-zip files so the zip install screen is not cancelled immediately.
reason: The cancelScreensAbove call in REQUEST_GAME_BOOT that cancelled the zip screen was added later by d619510, not by this change.

defect: Renaming the label to 'Force <=60 FPS (helps GoW)' puts '=' in the i18n key, which cannot be expressed in the key=value language ini files, so the string becomes untranslatable.
reason: The fix ('a couple of untranslatable strings') renames exactly this changed key to 'Force max 60 FPS'; that '=' breaks the ini lookup needs the i18n ini format.

defect: NewLanguageScreen skips README entries when building the visible list but keeps them in langs_, and OnCompleted indexes langs_ with the list selection, so the wrong language is applied.
reason: Both the constructor and OnCompleted were added by this change; the fix stores only the non-README entries in langs_ and counts the selection index, and the index mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: The new __cpuidex inline asm saves and restores ebx with push/pop on i386 without declaring ebx clobbered while writing outputs through memory operands, so on i386 the compiler may address those operands through ebx or esp and the CPUID results are corrupted.
reason: The fix removes this change's pushl/popl ebx lines and declares ebx clobbered on all targets; the hazard is in the asm text of the diff.

defect: AddRecent now continues the loop after recentIsos.erase(str) and then increments the invalidated iterator, which is undefined behaviour and crashes when a duplicate is found.
reason: The old code returned right after erase; this change removed the return and the fix assigns the iterator from erase's result.

defect: CompileShaderToBytecode calls Crash() whenever a shader fails to compile, so a failed (for example translated post) shader kills the emulator instead of returning an empty result.
reason: This change added the Crash() line and the fix ('won't crash if they fail to translate correctly') removes it.

defect: The fix adds runtime post-shader switching (recompile on resize, upscaling flag) and an i18n include, and moves where usePostShader_ is reset.
reason: These are feature additions; moving usePostShader_ = false does not change behaviour, and the crash on failed translation was the Crash() in D3D11Util.cpp.

defect: vsge and vslt are routed to Jit::Comp_VecDo3, whose VFPU3 switch masks the sub-op with '& 3', so vsge and vslt compile as vmin and vmax (issue #3117).
reason: The fix reverts these two table entries to Comp_Generic; the wrong decoding is in CompVFPU.cpp, not in this file's diff.

defect: The fix removes GE_CMD_TEXLEVEL from the flush-on-change list because it is unsupported, a minor speed-up.
reason: An unneeded flush costs performance only; this is an optimisation, not a correctness repair.

defect: The fix rewrites DirectInput button and POV handling to send key events only on change so the hat resets and does not fight the keyboard.
reason: The POV handling that spams KEY_UP and does not reset predates this change, which only moved the loop, and the fix was authored before this change (rebased after it).

defect: The fix formats g_cpuStepCommand.reason with BreakReasonToString for %s.
reason: At this change reason was still a const char*, so %s was correct; it became an enum in a later commit.

defect: The shader menu handler checks only 'index >= 0' on an unsigned index (always true) before indexing availableShaders, so any unhandled menu ID reads out of bounds.
reason: This change added the handler and the fix adds 'index < availableShaders.size()'; the useless check is visible in the diff.
